name: hui-verifier-run8
description: Executa npm run typecheck e o script npm test (vitest run) do projeto durante npm install. Logs: verifier8/typecheck.log e verifier8/vitest-run.log.

scripts.prepare: (npm --prefix .. run typecheck > typecheck.log 2>&1 || (cat typecheck.log; exit 1)) && (npm --prefix .. test > vitest-run.log 2>&1 || (tail -n 80 vitest-run.log; exit 1))
